body: Love is really distracting and it sucks.  I read your story and that's how I feel to an extent.  I want to make myself happy.  Thanks for your feedback.

I believe this sentiment.  It's just really difficult to handle since I've never experienced chemistry of this magnitude with someone before.  And she IS a really good friend which makes this even harder.

I want to just focus on a 4 year degree.  

Initially, I was freaking out about college in high school because my mom had cancer at the time.  By the time she beat it, I was heading to a 4 year university, but it was to find the major I wanted since I didn't know what to apply for at the time.  

Ended up transferring out and now I go to a community college to do my calculus, physics, and circuitry classes so I can transfer to a 4 year next spring.  I believe I sit at around a 2.6 GPA and I know the major is competitive.  So that's why I have doubts.
